assets.purpose: Cards diagram: Who to invite to a DITL interview (wide layout).

assets.purpose: Bars diagram: Current-state active time per case (fictional) (wide layout).
assets.license: Original diagram authored for this course; no third-party elements

assets.purpose: Flow diagram: From interview to annual burden (wide layout).
assets.license: Original diagram authored for this course; no third-party elements
assets.alt: A four-step calculation: frequency per person per day, multiplied by the affected population, multiplied by unit effort in hours, multiplied by working days, gives annual hours of burden. That result is capacity, not cash.

assets.purpose: Compare diagram: Current and future state (fictional) (wide layout).
assets.license: Original diagram authored for this course; no third-party elements
assets.alt: A comparison of a fictional support workflow before and after. Before: search several systems, ask a colleague and wait, then draft and review. After: ask once and get an answer that cites the approved article, escalate only when the answer is missing, and the agent still reviews and sends.
